text: KNOX Hydration is a South African hydration-drink brand co-owned by former UFC middleweight champion Dricus du Plessis and Ethan Hughes (the brand's Business Development Director), per Cape Argus, which also reports KNOX's sponsorship deal with Newcastle United. This source does not confirm a 2024 founding date, Cape Town headquarters, Hughes' nationality, or the company's legal/ownership structure.

source.name: Cape Argus (Independent Media): UFC Africa and Newcastle United: KNOX Hydration Working to Bring Global Giants to SA
source.quote: Hughes and du Plessis are the owners of a global hydration brand.
